cases.name: unit-inactive-unclosed-string-deferred
cases.source:
UBE SOURCE 1 MODULE
Attribute UBE_Name = "ParserUnit"
#If False Then
Dim Broken As String = "unterminated
#End If
Sub Work()
End Sub
cases.deferredReason: A future conditional-compilation consumer must select/recover inactive text without requiring the present whole-file raw scanner to accept its unclosed quote first. This definition neither implements that recovery nor admits the inactive text as core syntax.
